author: _Mx_
body: I don't know the rules of Avicus off by heart, but I do know that being rude isn't encouraged. I'm not sure if I was supposed to make a post report but I was told to if this happened. The screenshot: http://imgur.com/rsfXiW9 . The player 'dr_sasege' was saying things like this because he thought I hacked. He repeatedly hackusated in chat, so my response was: "If you think someone is hacking, please use /report (player) (Reason)". He hackusated again so I did that again incase he missed it. He told me "I have already reported" but yet still kept trying to say rude things. When I reported this in game I seemed to have no mods on, (which i understand as they are busy). Could someone tell me if I was supposed to make a post of this? Thanks, -Mx.
